Please do not return an online delivery order to your nearest Toyworld store
Online return items must be sent back to the store that originally fulfilled them
If your order came from more than one Toyworld store, you may receive more than one return address
Toyworld stores are independently owned and operated
For change-of-mind returns, return postage is your responsibility
Original delivery charges are non-refundable unless Toyworld is at fault, such as for a damaged or incorrect item

If your item is faulty, damaged, or not what you ordered, please report it through the Help Centre instead of sending it back as a standard return.

Once a returned item is received and accepted, refunds are usually processed within 3 to 5 business days back to the original payment method 😊
